Overview
FortiAI: AI Security and AI-Powered Defense, Unified
FortiAI protects your entire AI ecosystem—infrastructure, models, workloads, data and supply chains—while leveraging unified AI intelligence across the Fortinet Security Fabric to defend against threats at machine speed. Our unified defense secures LLMs, prevent shadow AI and data leaks through real-time scanning and risk-based access, and block AI-driven attacks in less than one second with minimal false positives. The mature ML engine and GenAI capabilities enables inline inspection, automated threat hunting, rapid response, and secure GenAI adoption—delivering proactive protection for AI and with AI.
See AI apps, stop AI threats
FortiAI-Protect provides comprehensive AI application visibility, risk assessment, and access control. It also enhances threat defense with better detection and accuracy. Plus, it includes advanced sandboxing to proactively uncover AI vulnerabilities and prioritize critical risks.
Automate NOC and SOC
FortiAI-Assist streamlines security operations by using AI for everything from alert triage and automated threat response to generating configuration scripts and assisting with troubleshooting. This boosts efficiency across the Fortinet Security Fabric.
Secure AI model, conversation, and data
FortiAI-SecureAI provides comprehensive security for LLM applications at runtime and blocks risky open-source models before deployment. It sanitizes inputs, filters outputs, and detects adversarial attacks. It also includes AI traffic optimization and load balancing.

Protects AI apps from web exploits

FortiAI embeds sixth-gen ML and GenAI across the Fortinet Security Fabric. Leveraging FortiGuard Labs AI-driven threat intelligence, the solution:
Blocks AI attacks in less than 1 second and minimizes false positives
Prevents shadow AI and data leaks via real-time scanning, DLP, and risk-based access
Detects AI threats, blocks rogue queries, and applies microsegmentation
Secures LLMs with guardrail chaining, anomaly detection, and secure inference
Delivers inline, low-latency inspection, faster resolution, and secure GenAI adoption

FortiAI FAQ
What exactly is FortiAI, and how is it different from other AI security tools?
FortiAI is a collection of AI/ML capabilities embedded directly into the Fortinet Security Fabric. Unlike standalone tools, it leverages Fortinet's integrated ecosystem to provide real-time, contextual threat analysis, automation, and guidance, turning insights into actionable, automated defense.
What specific problems does FortiAI solve for my security team?
It directly addresses the security skills gap and alert fatigue by automating complex tasks like incident investigation and policy tuning. It also provides deep visibility into AI application usage, helps secure your own AI projects from data leaks and misuse, and dramatically speeds threat response times.
How does FortiAI help me manage the risks of employees using Generative AI (like ChatGPT)?
It provides full visibility into all GenAI usage across your network. You can apply guardrails to control which applications are sanctioned, monitor for sensitive data sharing, coach users on correct behavior, and capture forensic artifacts for auditing and investigation.
Can FortiAI detect and stop unknown or zero-day attacks?
Yes. By using advanced deep learning models trained on Fortinet's global threat intelligence, FortiAI can analyze file behavior and network traffic to identify and block never-before-seen malware and zero-day exploits that bypass traditional signature-based defenses.
How does FortiAI improve my existing security operations?
It acts as a force multiplier for your SOC analysts. It can instantly summarize incidents, recommend and implement remediation actions, automate complex playbooks, and explain threats in plain language, freeing your team to focus on strategic tasks.
Is FortiAI a separate product, or does it work with my current Fortinet investments?
It is designed to integrate seamlessly across the Fortinet Security Fabric. It enhances products like FortiGate, FortiSIEM, and FortiAnalyzer with AI-powered capabilities, maximizing the value of your existing security infrastructure.
We are developing our own AI applications. How does FortiAI protect them?
FortiAI provides security for the AI life cycle. It helps you assess risks in AI models, monitor for model evasion attacks (like prompt injection or data poisoning), and enforce access controls to protect your proprietary models and training data.
How do we know the AI is trustworthy and won't make errors?
FortiAI models are continuously trained and validated on one of the world's largest and most diverse threat intelligence datasets. Its recommendations are based on real-world telemetry and are designed to be explainable, providing the reasoning behind its actions to build analyst trust.
What is required to deploy and maintain FortiAI?
As a deeply integrated component of the Fortinet platform, deployment is streamlined. It receives continuous updates and new threat intelligence automatically through FortiGuard AI-Powered Security Services, requiring minimal ongoing maintenance from your team.
What is the tangible ROI of implementing FortiAI?
The ROI is measured in three key areas:
Operational Efficiency
(faster MTTR, reduced manual tasks),
Risk Reduction
(prevented breaches, secured AI adoption), and
Cost Avoidance
(doing more with existing staff and tools, avoiding fines from AI misuse).
